subject: Changes to what is returned by session$clientData$url_hostname ?

messages.author: 1667ac6354bdba89
messages.subject: Changes to what is returned by session$clientData$url_hostname ?
parts:
Hi, I have apps that rely on detecting the hostname of the app for authentication, but today they stopped working.

Having a look why it seems that they are detecting https://internal.shinyapps.io/mark/xxxx/ rather than https://mark.shinyapps.io/xxxx/ which I don't think was happening before last week.

I detect the hostname via session$clientData$url_hostname - has this changed recently in what it detects?  The same code works fine locally, which is using 127.0.0.1

Yours sincerely,
Mark

messages.author: e84e7628b5f8a3e1
messages.subject: Re: [shinyapps-users] Changes to what is returned by session$clientData$url_hostname ?
parts:
Mark,

We did make some changes to the way applications are served that effect the session$clientData. As of this Monday, applications are served through iframes using the internal URL that you see. We are likely to make some additional changes to this, as we're still flushing out all the issues, but feel free to update your code to reflect these changes.

Sorry for the inconvenience,
-Andy
